newsitem.title: INDIA: India ITC slips on federal enquiry report.
newsitem.headline: India ITC slips on federal enquiry report.

text.p: Shares of Indian tobacco major ITC Ltd fell on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on Monday on newspaper reports of a federal enquiry into alleged violations of the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act (FERA), traders said.
ITC shares fell by 33.35 rupees, or over five percent, to 512.10 in early trade on the NSE.
The Business Standard newspaper said on Monday ITC directors accused of the $110 million FERA violation case will not be asked to resign from the board.
The federal Enforcement Directorate is investigating the case. Prime Minister I.K. Gujral declined to comment on the case, the Business Standard reported from New Delhi.
ITC is India's leading cigarette maker and is an affiliate of B.A.T. Industries Plc of U.K.
